Scene Window.notes: Hierarchy, selection, visibility, stack order, and generic nodes are covered.

Time Editor.notes: Timeline, keyframes, markers, and key selection are covered.

Graph Editor.notes: Key tangents/velocity and Graph attribute presets are covered; editor layout is not.

Viewport.notes: Capture and active-tool reads are covered; UI-only display profiles are not.

Attribute Editor.notes: Discovery, values, limits, expressions, and selection are covered.

Dependency Graph.notes: Connections and generic node inspection are covered.

Assets.notes: Files, groups, sequences, cloud sheets, smart folders, ICC data, and async callbacks are covered.

Control Centre.notes: Add/remove are structured; listing/description still have no stable public or Accessibility enumeration route.

Render Manager.notes: Queue basics are structured; format-specific attributes vary by installed definitions.

Tags.notes: No documented API or stable Accessibility identifiers; tools report PLATFORM_LIMITATION.

Presets.notes: Preset path/list and concrete menu commands are available; generic save/delete/rename/default operations remain unavailable.

Workspaces.notes: Enumeration and switching are available; persistent save/reset operations are explicitly interactive.

Shortcuts.notes: Discovery and explicit execution pass live through the optional macOS UI driver.

Preferences.notes: Explicit keyed read/write plus profile-key enumeration.

Tool Settings.notes: Scene-backed settings use attributes; editor-only settings remain unavailable.

Camera.notes: Planar cameras and safe cut/transition/sequence helpers are verified; native Camera Guides and 2.5D activation remain unavailable.

Third-party plugins.notes: Scene-node attributes are generic; custom plugin UI is inspected only where stable Accessibility controls are exposed.
